ValidationRule.description: Validation to make fields in user information section mandatory on selection of type as User Maintenance
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type_1__c,'User Maintenance'), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type_2__c,'Replacement User'), OR( ISBLANK(First_Name__c), ISBLANK(Last_Name__c), ISBLANK(Qantas_Staff__c), ISBLANK(User_s_Email__c), ISPICKVAL(Country__c,''), ISBLANK(Team_Position__c), ISBLANK(Reports_To__c), ISBLANK(AM_s_Manager__c) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill all user information for replace user maintenance request.
